author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The proposition produces a filtered complex representing the derived tensor product of two filtered complexes, with an explicit description of the first page of the associated spectral sequence in terms of the graded pieces, and records that under acyclicity and quasi-isomorphism conditions on the filtration the spectral sequence is bounded and converges. The proof chooses resolutions of the two complexes by filtered complexes with the properties established earlier, takes the total tensor product of the two resolutions, and invokes the spectral sequence for that filtered complex described in the text of the section and in the convergence lemma.
